name: xiao-c04b
why: Xiao's DC1 dungeon body (dun/mainchara/c04b.chr, model c04b.mds, 79 frames, skin 'skin' 19 bones / 3 influences) in DC2's player slot, with her Wooden Slingshot c04w01 (wave5-xiao-body). Xiao has no face/footl/footr/hat frames, so keri_L and keri_R are synthesised under the leg ball frames eff4 (+X) and eff26 (-X). Her shot leaves from the sling's eff30 (a weapon frame), so the body needs no melee hit frame. KEY 0-35 stay DC1 slots dc1_00..dc1_35; Max's 46 KEY names follow as aliases.

weapon: obj 19, child of jnt9_1 (+X arm; l_hand mesh is its sibling). Xiao's sling hangs in her LEFT hand (bind X +5.09, Y 11.2); the socket follows that joint by name.
item: obj 49, child of jnt21_1 (-X arm; r_hand mesh is its sibling), bind X -5.09, Y 11.2
eff2: obj 8, end of the spine chain (chest), bind Y 11.8; Toan's eff2 role (TOAN_C01D)
eff1: obj 5, end of the pelvis chain, bind Y 9.8; Toan's eff1 role

frame_renames_optional_absent.face: absent in body and shadow; Toan's face->hat row is omitted, not mapped
frame_renames_optional_absent.hat: no empty head-top frame (kao, obj 37, is meshed). Omitted, as in Goro's draft.

synth_frames.name: keri_L
synth_frames.why: +X leg: eff4 is the ball of the foot at bind (0.6605, 0.4, 1.0). Its frame is rotated (row Y -0.949), so the target is given in bind model space and solved through the chained .bbp; a rename would leave the floor 0.4 DC1 units high. Floor target 0.0 is Max's keri height (judgement).

synth_frames.name: keri_R
synth_frames.why: -X leg: eff26 at bind (-0.6605, 0.4, 1.0), same geometry as keri_L.

deform_frames_why: c04b base.cfg ALLOC_DBUFF lists skin AND o. o (obj 78, 105 triangles under dummyRoot) has no weight block, so validate_wgt refuses it as a skin frame (monster_converter.py validate_wgt). Only skin is skinned; o stays a rigid mesh.
weapon_hit_frame_why: No c04w chr has a dcol frame (all 11 checked). Xiao's damage is her CSHOT pool's (BattleActionPlay_Jinn, dun/gameloop.cpp:7667-7820), not a melee record on the weapon.
weapon_points_why: BattleActionPlay_Jinn spawns every shot at NowWeapon->frame->SearchFrame("eff30") (gameloop.cpp:7708, 7760): c04w01 frame 3 under pati2 > chn30 > jnt30_1.
